question: A man spends 30% of his salary on rent, 20% on groceries, and 25% on other expenses. If he saves Rs. 9,000, what is his salary?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total expenditure = 30% + 20% + 25% = 75%.

Remaining savings = 100% − 75% = 25%.

Given that 25% of the total salary corresponds to Rs. 9,000.

Total Salary (100%) = Rs. 9,000 × 4 = Rs. 36,000.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 36,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage spent on rent = 30%

Percentage spent on groceries = 20%

Percentage spent on other expenses = 25%

Total savings = Rs. 9,000
